name: Exploit Spirit (Pact)
body:
You are able to abuse the spirits that you seal pacts with in exchange for additional spell magic.

Prerequisite(s): Bind spirit class feature, ability to prepare 2nd-level arcane spells.

Benefit: When you seal a pact with a spirit, you can voluntarily increase the spirit’s binding DC by +5 in order to forgo one of the spirit’s minor granted abilities. In exchange, you can prepare one additional arcane spell per day of the highest level that you can cast (or lower).

You must decide which granted ability to give up before making the binding check. You may only forgo one granted ability at a time with this ability, even if you can seal pacts with multiple spirits.

Special: An arcanist can cast any spell she prepares with Exploit Spirit using her arcanist spell slots, but she cannot change her chosen spell for the duration of her pact, even with the quick study exploit.
